name: telegram-mcp
description: Secure Telegram Bot API integration for ChatGPT with OAuth, allowlisted chats, messaging, media uploads, channel management, and broad Bot API coverage.

interface.shortDescription: Send, manage, and automate Telegram content.
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to Telegram through a secure OAuth-enabled MCP server. Supports text, photos, documents, media uploads, message editing, moderation and channel/group operations with an allowlist.
